title: Reversio
description: A job scraper for Upwork, powered by AI models and RAG.

title: shiabox
description: AI-powered search engine for Shi'a ahadith, utilising a RAG architecture with Qdrant for the vector database and mxbai-embed-large for embeddings.

title: FindClients
description: Watches the Upwork job feed and searches X for people who are hiring, screens every lead with Gemini, and collects the good ones in one dashboard.

title: PolyMarket Bot
description: A Go-based Polymarket CLOB trading engine with real-time market feed processing, EIP-712–derived API credentials, HMAC-L2 authentication, and latency-tuned automated order execution.

title: CambridgePastPapersAI
description: Turns Cambridge past paper PDFs into one JSON record per question, tagged with topic and question type by Gemini.

title: Quizlet Flashcards Scraper
description: Backs up every public flashcard set in every public folder on a Quizlet profile, one text file per set.
